name: postcombat_main_sorcery_refused_on_opponents_turn
note: CR 307.1: a sorcery is cast during a main phase of its controller's OWN turn. On P1's turn, after P1's combat (P1's second main phase, CR 505.1), P0's Basri's Solidarity is refused ('window:not_your_turn'). A guard, green on main d0200d2 too: it pins that opening the second main phase did not open it to the non-active player.
